reviews.review_text:
Ivy Ysabelle O
1 contribution
0
Decent Enough
Apr 2026 • Couples
Disclaimer: This review is written from a non-vegetarian point of view.

Taste: ⭐️⭐️⭐️
We ordered the Vegetarian Crab Paste Soup with Noodles and the Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup with Noodles. Sadly, these were the only two dishes available when we arrived. As a non-vegetarian, these flavors were new to me, and I couldn't really make out the flavors or fully understand the taste. The food was decent enough that I finished it, but there was no "wow" factor.

Service: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The staff catered to our needs well, and they accept card payments, which is very convenient. We didn't wait long for our food, though we were the only customers at the time. It was disappointing that only two dishes were available, especially since they open at 7:00 AM. By the time we arrived at around 10:00 AM, we expected the full menu to be ready.

Vibe: ⭐️⭐️⭐️
We sat on the second floor. It was quiet with no traffic noise outside. The place has AC, but it wasn't turned on while we were there. Luckily, the weather was gloomy and not too hot. It’s a simple, okay place. Nothing fancy.

Cleanliness: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The shop is very clean. I didn’t see any flies or insects. They seem to maintain the place very well.

Value: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The portions are big and filling. For the price, you get a lot of food. The presentation is simple but decent.

Note: This was my partner’s second time eating here (he was the actual vegetarian in the duo), and he wasn't a fan. For me, it was an okay experience and a clean meal, even though the menu was very limited. It’s not the best, but it’s a filling option if you want to try it yourself!
